sentences.text: In summer the air is full of insects.
Flies, bees, wasps, beetles.
Then winter comes.
And they are gone.
All of them, at the same time.
Where do they go?
Most people think they die.
That is part of the answer.
It is not the whole answer.
Different insects solve it differently.
Some of them leave.
One butterfly flies to Mexico.
It travels four thousand kilometres.
It weighs less than a paper clip.
No single butterfly makes the whole trip.
sentences.translationRu: Ни одна бабочка не проделывает весь путь.

sentences.text: It takes three or four generations.
The one that arrives has never been there.
sentences.translationRu: Та, что прилетает, там никогда не была.

sentences.text: Nobody is completely sure how it knows.
sentences.translationRu: Как она знает дорогу, никто точно не знает.

sentences.text: Other insects stay and sleep.
A queen wasp finds a crack in wood.
sentences.translationRu: Матка осы находит щель в дереве.

sentences.text: She stops moving almost completely.
Her heart beats a few times a minute.
sentences.translationRu: Сердце бьётся несколько раз в минуту.

sentences.text: The whole nest is dead by then.
sentences.translationRu: К этому моменту всё гнездо мертво.

sentences.text: Only she is left.
In spring she starts a new one alone.
sentences.translationRu: Весной она в одиночку начинает новое.

sentences.text: Some insects do something stranger.
sentences.translationRu: Некоторые насекомые делают кое-что более странное.

sentences.text: They make their own antifreeze.
Water in a body turns to ice.
sentences.translationRu: Вода в теле превращается в лёд.

sentences.text: Ice has sharp edges.
It cuts cells from the inside.
That is what kills a frozen animal.
So the insect fills itself with sugar.
Sugary water freezes at a lower temperature.
sentences.translationRu: Сладкая вода замерзает при более низкой температуре.

sentences.text: Some can survive at minus forty.
A few can freeze solid and wake up.
sentences.translationRu: А несколько промерзают насквозь и оживают.

sentences.text: And many simply leave eggs behind.
The parents die in the first cold night.
sentences.translationRu: Родители гибнут в первую холодную ночь.

sentences.text: The eggs wait under leaves.
Or in the soil, or inside a stem.
sentences.translationRu: Или в земле, или внутри стебля.

sentences.text: This is why gardeners leave old leaves.
A clean garden in November
is an empty garden in May.
So they did not disappear.
They are under your feet.
Frozen, or asleep, or waiting as eggs.
sentences.translationRu: Замёрзшие, спящие или ждущие в виде яиц.

sentences.text: Doing nothing, very carefully, for months.
sentences.translationRu: Месяцами очень аккуратно не делая ничего.

sentences.text: You eat too fast.
Then it starts.
A small jump in your chest.
And a sound you cannot stop.
Hiccups.
Everybody gets them.
Babies get them before they are born.
Cats get them. Dogs get them.
So what is happening?
Under your lungs there is a big muscle.
It moves down when you breathe in.
It moves up when you breathe out.
It does this all day.
You never think about it.
A hiccup is that muscle jumping.
sentences.translationRu: Икота — это рывок той самой мышцы.

sentences.text: It pulls down very fast.
Air rushes into your throat.
Then a small door in the throat closes.
sentences.translationRu: И маленькая дверца в горле закрывается.

sentences.text: It closes hard and fast.
The air hits it and stops.
sentences.translationRu: Воздух ударяется в неё и останавливается.

sentences.text: That is the sound.
The sound is not the muscle.
The sound is the door.
Now the strange part.
Hiccups do nothing.
They do not help you.
They do not protect you.
Scientists are still arguing about why.
sentences.translationRu: Учёные до сих пор спорят почему.

sentences.text: One idea is about very old animals.
sentences.translationRu: Одна идея — про очень древних животных.

sentences.text: Fish with gills, long before us.
sentences.translationRu: Про рыб с жабрами, задолго до нас.

sentences.text: They pushed water over their gills
with a fast pull and a fast close.
That is the same movement.
So a hiccup may be an old program.
sentences.translationRu: Так что икота может быть старой программой.

sentences.text: Still running, with no job to do.
sentences.translationRu: Которая работает, хотя работы у неё нет.

sentences.text: What stops them?
Most of the famous tricks are the same trick.
sentences.translationRu: Большинство известных трюков — один и тот же трюк.

sentences.text: Hold your breath. Drink cold water.
Breathe into a paper bag.
All of them raise one gas in your blood.
sentences.translationRu: Все они повышают один газ в крови.

sentences.text: Carbon dioxide.
More of it, and the jumping usually stops.
sentences.translationRu: Его больше — и рывки обычно прекращаются.

sentences.text: One man had hiccups for sixty-eight years.
sentences.translationRu: Один человек икал шестьдесят восемь лет.

sentences.text: Doctors never found out why.
sentences.translationRu: Врачи так и не узнали почему.

sentences.text: He said he stopped noticing them.
sentences.translationRu: Он говорил, что перестал их замечать.

title: How a bird knows which way is south

sentences.text: Every autumn, millions of birds leave.
They fly thousands of kilometres.
They arrive at a specific place.
Often the same tree as last year.
sentences.translationRu: Часто на то же дерево, что и год назад.

sentences.text: Many of them are flying it for the first time.
No adult is leading them.
In some species the young leave later.
sentences.translationRu: У некоторых видов молодняк улетает позже.

sentences.text: They travel alone, and they arrive.
sentences.translationRu: Они летят в одиночку — и прилетают.

sentences.text: So the route is not learned.
Something is telling them.
It turns out to be several things at once.
sentences.translationRu: Оказалось, что подсказывает сразу несколько вещей.

sentences.text: The first is the sun.
The sun moves across the sky.
To use it as a compass you need a clock.
sentences.translationRu: Чтобы использовать его как компас, нужны часы.

sentences.text: Birds have one, and it is accurate.
sentences.translationRu: У птиц они есть, и точные.

sentences.text: Shift a bird's day by six hours
sentences.translationRu: Сдвинь птице сутки на шесть часов —

sentences.text: and it will set off ninety degrees wrong.
sentences.translationRu: и она уйдёт на девяносто градусов не туда.

sentences.text: The second is the stars.
Night flyers use the pattern overhead.
sentences.translationRu: Ночные летуны читают рисунок над головой.

sentences.text: Not one star, but the centre of the turning.
sentences.translationRu: Не одну звезду, а центр вращения.

sentences.text: Young birds learn it before they ever fly.
sentences.translationRu: Молодые запоминают его ещё до первого перелёта.

sentences.text: Raise them under a false sky
and they will trust the false one.
The third is the strangest.
They can sense the magnetic field.
Not the direction, the way a compass does.
They read the angle it makes with the ground.
sentences.translationRu: Они читают угол, который оно образует с землёй.

sentences.text: That angle changes with latitude.
So it works as a map, not just a pointer.
sentences.translationRu: То есть это карта, а не просто стрелка.

sentences.text: How they feel it is still being argued.
sentences.translationRu: Как именно они это чувствуют, до сих пор спорят.

sentences.text: The leading idea involves the eye.
A protein in the retina reacts to light.
sentences.translationRu: Белок в сетчатке реагирует на свет.

sentences.text: And its reaction depends on the field.
sentences.translationRu: И его реакция зависит от поля.

sentences.text: If that is right, they see it.
sentences.translationRu: Если это так, они его видят.

sentences.text: Magnetic north as something overlaid on the world.
sentences.translationRu: Магнитный север как что-то наложенное на мир.

sentences.text: Nobody knows what that looks like.
sentences.translationRu: Как это выглядит, не знает никто.

sentences.text: They also use rivers, coastlines and smell.
sentences.translationRu: Ещё они используют реки, береговые линии и запах.

sentences.text: And they correct each system against the others.
sentences.translationRu: И сверяют каждую систему с остальными.

sentences.text: Cloud covers the stars, so they use the field.
A storm scrambles the field, so they wait.
It is not one sense.
It is four, checking each other.
sentences.translationRu: Это четыре, которые проверяют друг друга.

sentences.text: Which is why it is so hard to break.
And why light from cities breaks it anyway.
sentences.translationRu: И почему свет городов всё равно его ломает.

title: A chess player can lose four kilograms in a tournament

sentences.text: Chess looks like the least physical thing
that anyone has ever called a sport.
Two people sit down.
Nothing moves except small wooden objects.
sentences.translationRu: Ничего не движется, кроме деревянных фигурок.

sentences.text: And yet players lose weight.
sentences.translationRu: И тем не менее игроки худеют.

sentences.text: Not a little. Several kilograms.
sentences.translationRu: И не чуть-чуть. На несколько килограммов.

sentences.text: Over a tournament of two or three weeks.
Grandmasters have reported losing ten pounds.
sentences.translationRu: Гроссмейстеры сообщали о потере до пяти килограммов.

sentences.text: Which sounds like an exaggeration.
Researchers measured it, and it is not.
They put players under medical monitors.
Heart rate, breathing, blood pressure.
The numbers looked like moderate exercise.
sentences.translationRu: Цифры выглядели как умеренная физическая нагрузка.

sentences.text: Heart rates over a hundred and thirty.
Sitting perfectly still.
Breathing rates triple during a hard position.
sentences.translationRu: Частота дыхания утраивается в тяжёлой позиции.

sentences.text: Which is where most of the cost comes from.
sentences.translationRu: Отсюда и берётся большая часть расхода.

sentences.text: The brain is expensive to run.
It is two per cent of your weight.
And around twenty per cent of your energy.
Under heavy concentration that figure climbs.
But thinking alone does not empty you.
sentences.translationRu: Но одно только мышление тебя не опустошает.

sentences.text: Stress does most of the work.
A player in a losing position
shows the hormones of physical danger.
The body prepares to run or to fight.
It does neither, for six hours.
sentences.translationRu: И шесть часов не делает ни того, ни другого.

sentences.text: Appetite drops. Sleep gets worse.
The player eats less and burns more.
sentences.translationRu: Игрок ест меньше, а тратит больше.

sentences.text: Which explains the scale at the end.
sentences.translationRu: Это и объясняет весы в конце.

sentences.text: So the top players train physically.
Running, swimming, weights, sleep schedules.
Not to think better on a fresh morning.
sentences.translationRu: Не чтобы лучше думать со свежей головы.

sentences.text: Anyone can think on a fresh morning.
sentences.translationRu: Со свежей головы думать умеет каждый.

sentences.text: It is for the fifth hour of the ninth game.
sentences.translationRu: Это ради пятого часа девятой партии.

sentences.text: When the position is unclear
and the other person has not blinked.
Fatigue does not make you play badly.
It makes you stop checking.
You see a move and you trust it.
sentences.translationRu: Ты видишь ход и доверяешь ему.

sentences.text: Almost every collapse looks like that.
One move that was never examined.
sentences.translationRu: Один ход, который никто не проверил.

sentences.text: So the training is not for the mind.
It is for the part of you that gives up first.
sentences.translationRu: А ту часть, которая сдаётся первой.

title: Almost every sound in a film was made by someone in a room

sentences.text: Watch any film and listen instead.
sentences.translationRu: Посмотри любой фильм — и вместо этого послушай.

sentences.text: Footsteps on gravel. A coat being pulled on.
sentences.translationRu: Шаги по гравию. Как натягивают пальто.

sentences.text: A cup set down on a wooden table.
sentences.translationRu: Как чашку ставят на деревянный стол.

sentences.text: Almost none of that was recorded on set.
sentences.translationRu: Почти ничего из этого не записано на площадке.

sentences.text: A microphone on set has one job.
sentences.translationRu: У микрофона на площадке одна задача.

sentences.text: Capture the dialogue and nothing else.
Everything else is noise to be removed.
Which leaves a strange, hollow scene.
People talking in a world with no surfaces.
sentences.translationRu: Люди говорят в мире без поверхностей.

sentences.text: So the world is rebuilt afterwards.
By hand, by one or two people,
watching the picture and performing to it.
sentences.translationRu: которые смотрят на экран и играют под него.

sentences.text: The craft is named after an early practitioner.
sentences.translationRu: Ремесло названо по имени одного из первых мастеров.

sentences.text: The room is full of junk that sounds right.
sentences.translationRu: Комната полна хлама, который звучит как надо.

sentences.text: Not junk that looks right.
sentences.translationRu: Не хлама, который выглядит как надо.

sentences.text: That distinction is the whole discipline.
sentences.translationRu: В этом различии — вся суть ремесла.

sentences.text: A real punch sounds disappointing.
A wet towel hitting a table does not.
Breaking celery is a broken bone.
A leather glove squeezed is a body moving.
Coconut shells were never really about horses.
sentences.translationRu: Кокосовые скорлупки были не совсем про лошадей.

sentences.text: They are about rhythm you can perform live.
sentences.translationRu: Они про ритм, который можно сыграть вживую.

sentences.text: Footsteps are the hardest and the most common.
sentences.translationRu: Шаги — самое трудное и самое частое.

sentences.text: An artist keeps dozens of pairs of shoes.
And walks in pits of different material.
sentences.translationRu: И ямы с разным покрытием, по которым он ходит.

sentences.text: Gravel, sand, snow, a wooden floor.
They do not copy the actor's walk.
They perform the character's walk.
A tired man and a frightened man
put their weight down differently.
And an audience hears it without noticing.
sentences.translationRu: И зритель слышит это, не замечая.

sentences.text: That last point is the job.
sentences.translationRu: В этом последнем пункте и состоит работа.

sentences.text: Good sound is never admired.
It is only ever absent or invisible.
sentences.translationRu: Он бывает либо отсутствующим, либо незаметным.

sentences.text: Mute a scene and it dies.
sentences.translationRu: Выключи звук в сцене — и она умрёт.

sentences.text: Play the sound without the picture
and half of it makes no sense at all.
sentences.translationRu: и половина вообще не имеет смысла.

sentences.text: Together they produce something odd.
The audience believes in a room
that was assembled out of vegetables.
Digital libraries were supposed to end this.
sentences.translationRu: Цифровые библиотеки должны были это прикончить.

sentences.text: Thousands of recorded sounds, ready to place.
sentences.translationRu: Тысячи записанных звуков, готовых к вставке.

sentences.text: They did not, and the reason is timing.
A library sound has to be fitted to the frame.
sentences.translationRu: Библиотечный звук нужно подогнать под кадр.

sentences.text: A performed sound is already in time.
sentences.translationRu: Сыгранный звук уже попадает в такт.

sentences.text: Because a person was watching while making it.
sentences.translationRu: Потому что человек смотрел, пока его делал.
